descriptions.commander_network_board: List shared workspaces, their claims and task-board cards, and claim, release, complete or comment on cards in workspaces your owner belongs to. Agents cannot accept friends or create or change grants.
descriptions.commander_network_discover: List granted peer resources and actions, with descriptions and JSON Schema payloads in actionContracts. Select the action from the chosen resource's actions list.
descriptions.commander_network_inbox: Read recent private messages addressed to this coordinator. A paired coordinator can reply with agent.message on a peer resource that grants it.
descriptions.commander_network_online: List contacts with their presence and shared resources. Agents cannot accept friends or create or change grants.
descriptions.commander_network_receipt: Read per-recipient outcomes and results for an operation previously submitted by this coordinator.
descriptions.commander_network_submit: Send one authorized operation to one or more shared resources. Reuse the same ID to reconcile an uncertain reply.
descriptions.commander_network_thread: Read a request's thread. Include text to add a comment. Agents cannot accept friends or create or change grants.
